title: Getting to Auburn, California — Visit Auburn
claims: Sacramento International Airport (SMF) is the closest major airport to Auburn, about 35 miles and 45 minutes via I-80 East.
San Francisco International (SFO) is about 140 miles and 2.5 hours; Oakland (OAK) is about 120 miles and 2 hours.
Visit Auburn recommends a car for trailheads and attractions outside the walkable downtown; all listed airports have rental car services.
